checks: Switching accounts immediately hides the previous session, even when the new request fails
A late unlock cannot overwrite the new member's balance or navigate to the old member's macro
Same-member token renewal preserves current builder input before its save debounce
Another member receives independent builder state and old draft writes stay retired
Logout removes owned work rather than exposing it in guest mode
Guest-created work continues after login and becomes owned by that member
scope: All APIs and WebSockets mocked; no production connections
